Description: Discussing the masterpieces of Russian literature — Dostoevsky, Gogol, Bulgakov and more.

Topics.Content: White Nights is a short but beautiful piece. What's your favorite Dostoevsky novel or short story?

Messages.Content: Crime and Punishment changed my perspective on morality. Absolutely my favorite.
I love White Nights for its dreamy atmosphere. It's so different from his heavier works.
The Brothers Karamazov is a masterpiece. The Grand Inquisitor chapter alone is worth reading.

Topics.Content: Dead Souls is such a brilliant satire of Russian society. What do you think Gogol was really trying to say?

Messages.Content: I think he was critiquing the absurdity of serfdom and the moral bankruptcy of the landowners.
The fact that it was left unfinished makes it even more mysterious and fascinating.

Description: Exploring the ideas from Thinking, Fast and Slow and how cognitive biases affect our daily choices.

Topics.Tittle: System 1 vs System 2 in real life
Topics.Content: Kahneman describes two systems of thinking. Can you share examples where you caught yourself using System 1 when you should have used System 2?

Messages.Content: I always fall for the anchoring effect when shopping. If I see a 'was $100, now $50' tag, I feel like it's a deal even if $50 is still overpriced.
Job interviews are a great example. First impressions (System 1) often dominate the entire evaluation even when you try to be objective.
I noticed it with news headlines. I form an opinion from the headline alone and rarely update it after reading the full article.
The sunk cost fallacy gets me every time. I'll keep watching a terrible movie just because I already spent an hour on it.

Topics.Content: Has reading this book actually changed how you make decisions? Or is knowing about biases not enough to overcome them?

Messages.Content: Knowing about biases helps me pause and reflect, but I still fall for them. Awareness is the first step though.
I started using checklists for important decisions at work. It forces System 2 thinking and has genuinely improved outcomes.
